events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of 'Fawlty Towers', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: To the man who gave us the Ministry of Silly Walks and some of the finest British comedy ever made. Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today, featuring classics like 'Back in the U.S.S.R.' and 'While My Guitar Gently Weeps'.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that was 'The White Album'. What's your favourite track from this double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legend Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, his stage presence, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today, showcasing a new lyrical maturity and musical experimentation.

angles.name: Revolutionary Record
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' and changed the game. A pivotal album that influenced countless artists.

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering John
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a legend. John Lennon's music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary David Bowie, a true innovator and chameleon of music.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. Forever pushing boundaries and inspiring us all.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. His influence is still undeniable.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, a true guitar god.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, rock and pop icon, turns 82 today.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs! Here's to the man who makes us 'One Step Beyond'.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Soulful Seventies
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that smooth voice.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the iconic Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Dolly's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, Dolly Parton, on what would have been her 81st birthday. Her music and spirit live on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting maestro.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British R&B and soul singer Billy Ocean, known for global hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Still making us want to dance.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame first induction (1989)
events.blurb: 38 years ago today, the very first Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and The Beatles.

angles.name: Hall Of Fame History
angles.copy: Remembering the inaugural Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction, 38 years ago. Who was your favourite from that first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer and songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: 58 years ago today, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert on Savile Row, their final public performance.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their last live performance. An unforgettable moment in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and frontman, and hugely successful solo artist, Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband to global icon.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, we lost three pioneers of rock and roll. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, known for his 80s smash hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still got the moves and that incredible voice.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Today would have been the 82nd birthday of reggae icon Bob Marley, whose music continues to spread messages of peace and unity worldwide.

angles.name: One Love, One Heart
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and legacy of Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His music is eternal.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, behind countless hits and the iconic album 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! A true songwriting genius whose music defines generations.
